text_cells.text: This document includes three training datasets and one testing dataset for image-based skin colour characterisation:
FSCD: 200 facial skin colour data collected from 40 human subjects.
SSCC: A silicone skin colour chart including 95 patches.
CCSG: A ColorChecker SG colour chart including 140 colour patches.
Testing: 100 facial skin colour data collected from another 20 human subjects.
